title: Onboard aurora-lite-4b v2.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Lin
release_notes: Add aurora-lite-4b v2.0 to model registry with performance profiles and automated changelog entry. Improvements: faster KV cache warmup and reduced memory footprint on 4xA100 configs.
description: Context: aurora-lite-4b v2.0 is a minor model refresh with a trimmed tokenizer and improved KV cache layout that reduces peak memory by ~12% and slightly improves short-sequence latency. This PR adds the model metadata, performance profiles for our supported GPU shapes, and wires the onboarding steps into the changelog automation so releases are published automatically. Motivation: enable teams to test the lighter 4b variant with validated perf profiles and ensure release notes are generated as part of model metadata CI. Changes included: - model metadata (models/aurora-lite-4b/v2.0/metadata.json) with model signature, quantization compatibility, and recommended runtime knobs - perf profiles (profiles/aurora-lite-4b/v2.0/*) for gpu_4xA100_p4d, gpu_1xA10g, and cpu inference (small) - extractor and template for changelog automation (scripts/changelog/generate_model_release.py) to create standardized changelog entries consumed by the release pipeline - small unit tests and integration harness updates to validate perf profile keys and serialization - docs and example snippet in docs/models/aurora-lite-4b.md Checklist: - [x] Metadata schema validated (schema v1.3) - [x] Perf profiles run on CI perf-lab (baseline & new) - [x] Changelog automation integrated and tested locally - [x] Docs updated for examples and runtime knobs - [x] Sign-off from performance and model-ops reviewers How to review: focus on metadata fields (input_signature, tokenizer_hash, quantization_recommendations), performance numbers for each profile, and the changelog generation template. CI notes: perf CI runs are gated and were re-run twice due to transient failures on the p4d cluster; final run passed. Related: ENG-4321 contains the tracking for aurora family onboarding. Merge strategy: squash merge into main and tag release as model/aurora-lite-4b@v2.0
